description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a hggroup graphics object.

tr.td: updates the annotation metadata used by interactive tools and object inspection.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object associated with the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle when no annotation is attached.
Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls whether an interrupting callback is queued or canceled.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
parenting operations update the vector.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates the label used by legend entries and object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
controls whether handle-search functions can find the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
includes or excludes the object from mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls whether a running callback can be interrupted.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
reparents the object and updates Children on the old and new parents.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: a valid parent handle for the object class.
selects which visible or invisible parts can receive mouse hits.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
